from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();label=sys.argv[1];out=root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-classes');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
classpath=(root/'tmp/completion-integrity-runtime-classpath.txt').read_text().strip()
jdk=root/'tmp/amazon-corretto-25.0.2.10.1/bin'
sources=list((root/'backend/src/main/java/com/skillpilot/backend/identity').glob('*.java'))+[root/'backend/src/test/java/com/skillpilot/backend/identity/GoalIdentityServiceTest.java',root/'backend/src/test/java/com/skillpilot/backend/identity/GoalStateProjectionTest.java',root/'tmp/IdentityOwnerContractJUnit.java']
bindings=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sources]
(root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-input-pins.json')).write_text(json.dumps(bindings,indent=2)+'\n')
with (root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-compile.log')).open('w') as log:
 compiled=subprocess.run([str(jdk/'javac'),'-cp',classpath,'-d',str(out),*[str(p) for p in sources]],cwd=root/'backend',stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert compiled.returncode==0,'Compilation failed'
with (root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-junit.log')).open('w') as log:
 result=subprocess.run([str(jdk/'java'),'-Xmx384m','-cp',str(out)+':'+classpath,'com.skillpilot.backend.identity.IdentityOwnerContractJUnit',str(root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-results.json'))],cwd=root/'backend',stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert bindings==[{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sources]
print(json.dumps({'compileExit':compiled.returncode,'junitExit':result.returncode,'result':json.loads((root/'tmp'/('identity-owner-'+label+'-results.json')).read_text()),'classpathSha256':hashlib.sha256(classpath.encode()).hexdigest(),'sourceHashesUnchangedDuringRun':True}))
sys.exit(result.returncode)
